sn1.13:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi. || ||
sn1.13:2.1: Natthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ || natthi gosamitam dhanaṃ || natthi suriyasamā ābhā. || samudda paramā sarāti || ||
sn1.13:3.1: Natthi attasamaṃ pemaṃ || natthi dhaññasamaṃ dhanaṃ || natthi paññāsamā ābhā || vuṭṭhi ve paramā sarā ti || ||
